section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种基于人工智能的机器学习装置，属于人工智能领域。一种基于人工智能的机器学习装置，包括底板，底板上部开设有滑槽，滑槽内设有螺纹杆，螺纹杆后端连接有电动机A，螺纹杆上方设有滑块，滑块上方设有齿环，齿环中部设有固定环，固定环外侧设有调节手轮，固定环内设有摄像头，齿环左侧设有齿轮，齿轮后方设有电动机B，齿环前方设有电动机C，电动机C前端连接有转动杆，底板前端安装有显示屏。本装置能够有效的对机器学习进行辅助。

The utility model discloses a machine learning device based on artificial intelligence, and belongs to the field of artificial intelligence. The utility model provides a machine learning device based on artificial intelligence, comprising a base plate, the spout has been seted up on bottom plate upper portion, be equipped with the threaded rod in the spout, the threaded rod rear end is connected with motor A, the threaded rod top is equipped with the slider, the slider top is equipped with the ring gear, the ring gear middle part is equipped with solid fixed ring, gu the fixed ring outside is equipped with adjusting hand wheel, gu be equipped with the camera in the fixed ring, the ring gear left side is equipped with the gear, the gear rear is equipped with motor B, ring gear the place ahead is equipped with motor C, motor C front end is connected with the dwang, the display screen is installed to the bottom plate front end. This device can be effectual assist machine learning.

Machine learning device based on artificial intelligenceTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the field of artificial intelligence, in particular to a machine learning device based on artificial intelligence.

Background

Sketch recognition can be applied to many fields, such as early education of children, type recognition and retrieval of the same category can be carried out based on hand-drawn sketches, and the growth of divergent thinking and graphic understanding ability of children is very important; but may also be used in other graphic retrieval systems. The prior patent document with publication number CN110633745A provides an image classification training method, device and storage medium based on artificial intelligence, where the classification training device will select a training set first, determine the category of a sketch in the training set according to a sketch classification model, and can identify sketch features obtained in the sketch classification model according to a real-image identifier to obtain a second sketch feature identification result; and then fixing the real chart classification model and the sketch identifier, and adjusting the fixed parameter value of the sketch classification model according to the class of the sketch and the second sketch feature identification result. Therefore, when the fixed parameter value of a certain classification model (such as a sketch classification model) is adjusted, the error of the classification of the corresponding image by referring to the classification model is also used for reference of useful information of another classification model (such as a fixed real sketch classification model) in the classification process, so that the classification calculation of the adjusted sketch classification model is more accurate. Although the device has more beneficial effects, the following problems still exist: in practical application, the sketch captured by the camera can interfere with image recognition due to uncertain factors such as distance and angle, and the device does not take the factors into account, so that training of machine learning is not comprehensive enough. In view of this, we propose a machine learning apparatus based on artificial intelligence.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

1. Technical problem to be solved

The present invention is directed to a machine learning device based on artificial intelligence to solve the above problems.

2. Technical scheme

The utility model provides a machine learning device based on artificial intelligence, includes the bottom plate, the spout has been seted up on bottom plate upper portion, be equipped with the threaded rod in the spout, the threaded rod rear end is connected with motor A, the threaded rod top is equipped with the slider, the slider top is equipped with the ring gear, the ring gear middle part is equipped with solid fixed ring, gu the fixed ring outside is equipped with adjusting handle, gu be equipped with the camera in the fixed ring, the ring gear left side is equipped with the gear, the gear rear is equipped with motor B, ring gear the place ahead is equipped with motor C, motor C front end is connected with the dwang, the display screen is installed to the bottom plate front end.

Preferably, the motor A is fixedly installed on the bottom plate, the output end of the motor A is fixedly connected with a threaded rod, and the threaded rod is in threaded connection with the sliding block.

Preferably, slider and spout sliding connection, the slider rotates with solid fixed ring to be connected, gu fixed ring and adjusting hand wheel threaded connection, gu fixed ring and camera sliding connection.

Preferably, the fixing ring is rotatably connected with the bottom plate, the fixing ring is fixedly connected with the toothed ring, the toothed ring is meshed with the gear, and the gear is fixedly connected with the output end of the motor B.

Preferably, the output end of the motor C is fixedly installed on the rotating rod, and the display screen is fixedly installed on the bottom plate.

3. Advantageous effects

Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that:

1. according to the utility model, the camera is fixed in the fixed ring, so that when the threaded rod rotates again, the camera can be driven to move by pushing the sliding block, the distance between the camera and the display screen is changed, the captured image is further changed, actual uncertain factors can be added when the machine is trained, and the learning effect of the machine is improved. The utility model has compact structure and reasonable design, and can effectively assist the machine to learn.

2. According to the utility model, the gear is arranged, so that the motor B can drive the gear ring to rotate, the gear ring can drive the camera to rotate through the fixing ring, and pictures after the sketch captured by the camera rotates are provided for the learning of a machine; in addition, through the dwang that sets up, can rotate under motor C's the drive, shelter from the display screen for the camera can catch and be sheltered from the picture, increases the effect of machine training.

Detailed Description

In the description of the present invention, it is to be understood that the terms "center", "longitudinal", "lateral", "length", "width", "thickness", "upper", "lower", "front", "rear", "left", "right", "vertical", "horizontal", "top", "bottom", "inner", "outer", "clockwise", "counterclockwise", and the like, indicate orientations and positional relationships based on those shown in the drawings, and are used only for convenience of description and simplicity of description, and do not indicate or imply that the equipment or element being referred to must have a particular orientation, be constructed and operated in a particular orientation, and thus, should not be considered as limiting the present invention.

In the description of the present invention, "a plurality" means two or more unless specifically defined otherwise.

In the description of the present invention, it should be noted that, unless otherwise explicitly specified or limited, the terms "mounted," "disposed," "sleeved/connected," "connected," and the like are to be construed broadly, e.g., "connected," which may be fixedly connected, detachably connected, or integrally connected; can be mechanically or electrically connected; they may be connected directly or indirectly through intervening media, or they may be interconnected between two elements. The specific meanings of the above terms in the present invention can be understood in specific cases to those skilled in the art.

Referring to fig. 1-3, the present invention provides a technical solution:

a machine learning device based on artificial intelligence comprises a bottom plate 1, wherein a sliding groove 2 is formed in the upper portion of the bottom plate 1, a threaded rod 3 is arranged in the sliding groove 2, the rear end of the threaded rod 3 is connected with a motor A4, a sliding block 5 is arranged above the threaded rod 3, a toothed ring 6 is arranged above the sliding block 5, a fixing ring 7 is arranged in the middle of the toothed ring 6, an adjusting hand wheel 8 is arranged outside the fixing ring 7, a camera 9 is arranged in the fixing ring 7, a gear 10 is arranged on the left side of the toothed ring 6, a motor B11 is arranged behind the gear 10, a motor C12 is arranged in front of the toothed ring 6, a rotating rod 13 is connected to the front end of the motor C12, and a display screen 14 is mounted at the front end of the bottom plate 1; through fixing the camera in the fixed ring for when the threaded rod rotated again, can drive camera 9 through promoting the slider and remove, change the distance between camera 9 and the display screen 14, and then change the image of catching.

Specifically, motor A4 is fixed with the installation of bottom plate 1, and motor A4's output is connected fixedly with threaded rod 3, threaded rod 3 and 5 threaded connection of slider for threaded rod 3 can push slider 5 and move.

Further, slider 5 and 2 sliding connection of spout, slider 5 and solid fixed ring 7 rotate and are connected, gu fixed ring 7 and 8 threaded connection of adjusting hand wheel, gu fixed ring 7 and camera 9 sliding connection for camera 9 can be convenient install in solid fixed ring 7.

Still further, fixed ring 7 is connected with bottom plate 1 rotation, and fixed ring 7 is connected fixedly with ring gear 6, and ring gear 6 is connected with gear 10 meshing, and gear 10 is connected fixedly with the output of motor B11 for ring gear 6 can rotate under the drive of gear 10.

Furthermore, the output end of the motor C12 is fixedly installed on the rotating rod 13, and the display screen 14 is fixedly installed on the bottom plate 1, so that the display screen 14 can display images, and the images can be conveniently replaced.

The working principle is as follows: when the device is used, images are displayed on the display screen 14, and the images on the display screen 14 are captured through the camera 9; the motor A4 is controlled to rotate by an external control mechanism, so that the threaded rod 3 can be driven by the motor A4 to rotate, the slide block 5 which is in threaded connection with the threaded rod 3 can slide in the chute 2, the distance between the camera 9 fixed in the fixed ring 7 and the display screen 14 can be adjusted, and the captured image can be changed; then, the motor B11 is controlled to rotate by an external control mechanism, so that the motor B11 can drive the toothed ring 6 to rotate through the gear 10, the toothed ring 6 drives the camera 9 to rotate through the fixing ring 7, the rotation angle of the camera 9 is changed, and the captured image is changed; in addition, the rotating rod 13 can be driven to rotate by the arranged motor C12, the display screen 14 is shielded, and images captured by the camera 9 are changed.

The foregoing shows and describes the general principles, essential features, and advantages of the utility model. It will be understood by those skilled in the art that the present invention is not limited to the embodiments described above, and the preferred embodiments of the present invention are described in the above embodiments and the description, and are not intended to limit the present invention. The scope of the utility model is defined by the appended claims and equivalents thereof.
